sources_considered.why: Dated interview contains the CEO's profitability assertion and describes Gamma's use of LLMs. It lacks financial definitions and billing-level accounts.
Describes monthly and annual subscriptions linked to internal token tracking, but no publication or revision date was established.
Corroborates subscriptions and a historical profitable milestone, but does not establish how each customer's actual consumption affected charges.
Primary press release repeats historical company-wide profitability without defining the measure or linking it to particular billing terms.

evidence_items.locator: Section 'On jobs and saying no to acquirers', closing CEO quotation
evidence_items.explanation: The article describes Gamma's use of LLMs and quotes its CEO claiming profitability. This challenges the universal assertion, but does not establish the billing basis and service-level economics required by the early-resolution rule.

unresolved_gaps: Gamma's reported profitability is not accompanied by a defined financial measure and matched billing records.
The retrieved dated records do not establish whether a qualifying service earned sustained profits without actual per-user token billing.
No finite period without a verified counterexample establishes 'never will be'.
